title: Jīvakambavane
text: 1 Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Jīvakambavane || || 2 Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū amantesi Bhikkhavoti || la || || 3 Samādhim bhikkhave bhāvetha || samāhitassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno yathābhūtam okkhāyati [page 144] 144 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 159. 4 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Kiñca yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || 4 Cakkhum aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Rupā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhusamphasso aniccoti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitam || pe || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || 5-8 Sotaṃ || Ghānaṃ || Jivhā || Kāyo || || 9 Mano aniccoti yathābhutam okkhāyati || Dhammā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || la || Yam pidam mano samphassapaccayā uppajjati sukkhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || 10 Samādhim bhikkhave bhāvetha || samāhitassa bhikkhuno yathābhūtam okkhāyatīti || ||
